title: 大阪杯の後に・それでも走れ

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Gold City's awesome! She always has the face of a model, even when she's running so fiercely!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Seriously! She's the real deal, and she brings a touch of glamour to the race to boot. I hope she runs a lot in her senior year as well!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Screw this.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: City!
As Gold City returns from her race, she sees her manager waiting with a stern expression.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: Hey, City. What was that today?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: I've watched you in all your races, and never have you looked so… unbeautiful.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Unbeautiful?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: I'm not talking about your results. I'm talking about you, City.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: Before, you raced with such passion. I don't know where that passion came from, but it was what made you so eye-catching.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: That's why I allowed you so much flexibility with work, and why I watched you run.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: But I didn't get any of that today. You looked empty.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Empty? You… might be right.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I do feel empty right now.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: Then… why don't you consider calling it quits? You've worked hard enough.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: As an adult, I can't just stand by and watch you compete looking so unsightly.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: I get that you don't want to be judged on looks alone. But if you keep at it, one day it'll be your name, your brand that earns respect.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: Running isn't the only path there. You will be appreciated for who you are. So please…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I…
Gold City is trying to catch her breath. I can't just stand here and nod along.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Trainer?
choice_data_list: If she quits now, she's going to regret it.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: …I'm sorry, but do you know what's making City like this in the first place?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: It's you, forcing her to race without a second thought.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: You're not respecting what she wants, you're just pushing running on her.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: You don't realize the consequences City has to suffer, the damage it could do to her life.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: If she keeps running like this, it's only going to hurt her. Do you really think that's what's best for her?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Uh, that's going a bit too fa—
choice_data_list: But City still hasn't told me she actually wants to quit.

text_block_list.text: Even after failing to change her image, even as she laments that there's no point anymore, she still hasn't given up on running itself. That's why…
choice_data_list: Until I hear those words come from her mouth, I'm going to keep her racing.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: That right there is exactly what I'm talking about! Sigh… This is getting nowhere.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: Look, how about this? Let her race one more time, but if nothing changes after that…

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: You and her are finished. No more running. Is that fine with you, City?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: …Hate me if you want. See you at work.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well… that got heated.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Don't apologize. You're just… trying to do what's best for me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I know, I'm not some little kid. She's always looked out for me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But… that's why I can't let things stand like this.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Both of you are working so hard for me. Meanwhile I've all but given up on myself.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I don't want someone else to decide my future. Not you, not my manager… no one.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So I need to figure it out. What I really want to do.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, my next race… It would be the spring Tenno Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure to figure it out by then. This… whatever it is that I'm lacking—this emptiness.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: 'Cause I don't want to end up hating you, or my manager… or myself.
